description: A long one-bedroom down the west side of the twenty-sixth floor, glass on three sides and the mountains filling the end of it. Oak, pale plaster, a platform bed, a galley kitchen in grey stone. Leave east to the landing.

window.description: A tall pane runs floor to ceiling down one wall, black-framed, holding the city out there like something in a case.
window.name: the window

name: Solenne Residence 26-A
